title: JANUS Face Microcontrol Learning Update v2.1 — Independence Is Lineage, Replay Is Request Identity, and Unknown Must Stay Unknown

new_lessons.learning: Idempotency cannot be bolted onto the executor after the fact. The caller boundary must preserve a stable request identity across retry/restart.

Recovery must reason from durable evidence, not from what a test harness privately knows. Once the durable record says the world call may have started, absence of receipt cannot be upgraded to NO_EFFECT.
When the world result is durably receipted but an outer session write crashes, the correct retry is to reuse the receipt, not invoke the world again.
A monitoring layer is safer when its audit failure cannot become a hidden veto, duplicate executor, or new source of world authority.
Comparing exact outputs from independent stochastic executions can falsely accuse a transparent adapter. Test the exact forwarded call, deterministic projection, or controlled seed instead.
Clone/fork multiplicity is not independent criticism. Ten descendants of one lineage cannot manufacture ten independent review seats.
When independent review is constitutionally required and unavailable, JANUS should admit the shortage instead of satisfying the quota with correlated clones.
Routing reputation can optimize ordinary attention, but new counterevidence from an independent lineage must retain a path into review.
Internal faces cannot vote an ambiguous provider transaction into existence or nonexistence. Reconciliation must bind to the external effect identity and provider evidence channel.

Two more verifier failures strengthened the protocol: missing CI dependencies and a stochastic-equivalence mistake in v6.2, plus brittle line-oriented constitutional assertions in the first v6.3 run. Each failure was preserved, corrected, and followed by a fresh complete run.

microcontrol_compression_v2_1: MANY_FACES -> DISTINCT_LINEAGES_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW -> MANY_PROPOSALS -> STABLE_CALLER_REQUEST -> ONE_PROTECTED_RUNTIME_EFFECT -> DURABLE_CALL_BOUNDARY -> ZERO_OR_ONE_CANONICAL_WORLD_CALL_WHEN_RECEIPTED_OR_UNDETERMINED -> EXTERNAL_RECEIPT_OR_PROVIDER_RECONCILIATION -> APPEND_ONLY_LEARNING_AND_FAILURE_LINEAGE

epistemic_upgrade.before: unknown was mostly protected at SOURCE/WORLD/RECEIPT boundaries
epistemic_upgrade.after: unknown is now also protected across process crash, session retry, canonical runtime entry, stochastic verifier behavior, and external provider reconciliation
epistemic_upgrade.formula: DURABLE_EVIDENCE > INTERNAL_MEMORY; INDEPENDENT_LINEAGE > FACE_MULTIPLICITY; RECEIPT/RECONCILIATION > CONSENSUS

next_learning_question: How should JANUS persist caller request identities for non-AI-link clients, attest lineage roots so forks cannot lie about independence, and bind provider-specific verification without turning external adapters into unexamined roots of trust?
